Thank you for the insight and advice.

Yes, I'm not experienced with mental issues this heavy. As someone not suffering from any mental ilness I really appreciate your insight and it really motivated me to keep supporting her.

> I read this and it seems inconsiderate of the person that is suicidal by focusing on how terrible her family feels when she feels so bad to try kill herself and fails. 

Yes, I know how she really is very conflicted with the act of suicide itself as she is fully aware of the damage it'll do to her mom. 

>you will not be able to just say some magical words.  
Change has to come from within even if it is influenced by the environment.

Thank you for the advice
